name: zangoh-supervisor-workstation
description: AI Agent Supervisor Workstation: monitor, intervene in and tune AI customer-service agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n llm,vdb,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green,blue "npm run dev -w mock-llm" "npm run dev -w vector-db" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n llm,vdb,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green,blue "npm run start -w mock-llm" "npm run start -w vector-db" "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w mock-llm && npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
